jobs.description: Why is now the right time to join SysAid? | SysAid Careers Why is now the right time to join SysAid? Avi Kedmi · CEO SysAid Management Israel In the video, Avi Kedmi, CEO of SysAid, passionately shares why now is the perfect time to join the company. With SysAid at the forefront of the AI revolution, Avi highlights how their service management solution is transforming the IT landscape. He likens it to a candy store for developers, marketers, and customer success professionals, where they have access to all the data needed to create an almost fully AI-contained environment. Avi's enthusiasm reflects the innovative and dynamic atmosphere at SysAid, where the dream of revolutionizing IT work is becoming a reality. Show full transcript » Hide transcript Full transcript People ask me why join CSAID and why now. And the reason is, there is an AI revolution. I think we're all seeing it, but CSAID is in the front of it. CSAID has a service management solution. It's like a candy store for kids. You have, as a developer, as a marketer, as a customer success, you have all the data in front of us, in order for us to build an amazing, almost fully AI-contained environment. So the dream of many, many, many people that are doing IT work on a day to day, that's been transformed by them having AI doing it, is coming to reality. And that's what we do. Gil Alter · Director of Channels and Alliances SysAid Sales Israel In the video, Gil Alter, Director of Channels and Alliances at SysAid, highlights the innovative use of AI within their IT service management solutions. His role in the Sales department involves showcasing how SysAid's technology empowers IT departments by enabling AI-driven auto-resolution for common queries, enhancing efficiency and user satisfaction. Based in Israel, Gil passionately shares how SysAid's mission revolves around transforming IT support through cutting-edge AI, making everyday tasks seamless for employees worldwide. Show full transcript » Hide transcript Full transcript Every company has an IT department, so what's different about CC product? We're at CSAID, an ITSM company, IT service management, who uses AI in everything we do. That means that employees within companies can ask questions to the help desk and to the AI and get it auto-resolved before it even gets to the help desk. For example, they can open a ticket and say, "What's the Wi-Fi password to the company? How do I understand and know it?" The AI will know to give the employee, the end users, an answer immediately. We use AI in everything, and this is only one example in a nutshell of what we do here at CSAID. Avi Kedmi · CEO SysAid Management Israel Avi Kedmi, CEO of SysAid, shares the company's unique value of "CEO mode activated," where every employee is encouraged to think and act like a CEO or founder. This empowering approach fosters a culture of ownership and proactive problem-solving, where team members are driven to build and innovate with courage. At SysAid, employees are not just part of a team; they are integral to the company's success, contributing with a founder's mindset to create impactful change. Show full transcript » Hide transcript Full transcript People ask me about CEO mode activated which is one of our values. Let me tell you what it is. CEO mode activated or you may call it maybe founder mode is where each one of our employees has to act as if they're the CEO of the company. Whether if they see a paper on the floor that's some garbage they need to take or they have a marketing campaign or they think something that the company is doing is really wrong. As long as your mind is as if you're the CEO or the founder you can never make some sort of the wrong perspective into your decision. So these are type of people they're looking for. Founders, people that want to be part of building something and have the courage to do them.
